camel_example: aliyun gwlb GetListenerHealthStatus --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken 4f1d7cc9f51e18904e8a063603a6b0c3d03bc69f78734254e0b5e8707e680000 --MaxResults 20 --Skip 10 --Filter.1.Values.1 Unhealthy --Filter.1.Name Status --ListenerId 'lsn-7sixpvm5fc3v0b0000' --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the health check status of a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) listener
description_zh: 查询负载均衡实例监听的健康检查状态
name: GetListenerHealthStatus

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no next page exists.
If a value of NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token that is used for the next query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~1000，默认值为 20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to be skipped in the call
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，跳过的条目数
parameters.name: skip

element_fields.help_en:
The filter condition name. You can filter by one or more filter condition names. The URL must meet the following requirements:

Status: the health status.
ReasonCode: the cause of an unhealthy server.
ServerId: the ID of the backend server.
ServerIp: the IP address of the backend server
element_fields.help_zh:
动态查询条件名称，可选择一个或者多个名称进行查询。取值范围：
Status：健康检查状态。
ReasonCode：Status 为异常状态时的详细原因。
ServerId：后端服务器ID。
ServerIp：后端服务器IP地址
element_fields.name: name

element_fields.help_en: The filter condition values. You can specify at most 20 condition values
element_fields.help_zh: 动态查询条件的值列表。一次最多添加20个值
element_fields.name: values

parameters.help_en: The filter conditions. You can specify at most 20 filter conditions
parameters.help_zh: 动态查询条件列表。一次最多添加20个动态查询条件
parameters.name: filter
